text:
Elaine (PM): Quick sync — we need to sequence the prefetch cache rollout for the tiered-latency pilot. Asking runtime/infra/security for blockers and approximate lead times so we can lock the launch window.
Sam (Runtime): Working assumption: runtime changes are a canary + global flag. Need to land prefix-cache + dynamic batching. Estimate 10 dev days + 3 days of staging validation.
Marta (Infra): Infra needs a small VPC change for cache nodes and a prewarm job. Network ACL and autoscaling policy edits — ~7 business days if no surprises. Also need a kube node pool resized for prewarm.
Devon (Security): Security needs threat model and KMS access pattern doc. If customers need dedicated HSM/KMS binding, that's an extra approval (SOC2 PCI path). Timeline: 5 business days after docs + scheduling. No sign-off before pen test window.
Ryan (Eng): On the app side we'll add a graceful degrade path to fall back to standard model when cache misses spike. Can implement a toggle for 0.5ms fallback threshold.
Elaine (PM): Thanks. Can everyone call out the earliest safe launch date if we start work Monday 2026-04-06?
Sam (Runtime): Earliest runtime ready: 2026-04-20 (dev + 3 days staging). Needs quantization toggle QA with model-team — pinged @model-team.
Marta (Infra): If infra changes start 4/6 and we parallelize with runtime, earliest infra ready: 2026-04-17. But node-pool resize needs a maintenance window — prefer weekend 4/18-4/19 for the prewarm.
Devon (Security): If we get the threat model today, we can review by 4/13. Pen-test scheduling adds 7 days; realistic security sign-off: 4/24 unless we scoping-lift pen-test.
Olivia (ProductOps): Launch criteria proposal: p50 latency <= 120ms for cached requests, cached hit-rate >= 65% on pilot traffic, error rate < 0.5%, rollbackable within 15 mins. Also need documented customer opt-in flow.
Ryan (Eng): For rollbackability we need a fast route to disable cache at the router layer — will add a /admin toggle and an emergency job to flush KV. ETA for that infra+app hook: 4/16.
Sam (Runtime): Small config snippet for rollout plan I'll drop in the doc:
```
rollout:
  phase1: staging (100%)
  phase2: canary (5% prod)
  phase3: ramp (25 -> 50 -> 100)
  abort_on:
    cpu: 85%
    error_rate: 0.5%
```
Keep in mind batching behavior changes when the cache is on.
Elaine (PM): Action items: (1) Sam: add canary + abort signals to the runbook (due 4/9). (2) Marta: reserve maintenance window and update infra runbook (due 4/10). (3) Devon: review threat model and list any attestation / HSM needs (due 4/9). (4) Ryan: implement admin toggle + flush job (due 4/13). Olivia: finalize launch criteria and customer opt-in text (due 4/9). I'll coordinate cross-team dry-run for 4/20.
Marta (Infra): noted. I'll also add an autoscaler safeguard to prevent prewarm from causing noisy neighbor issues.
Devon (Security): I'll scope minimal pen-test and see if we can bundle with ongoing weekly tests to save time. If we can, sign-off might be 4/20. Will post blocker list in the doc.
Ryan (Eng): One ask — does the team want model fallback variants pinned per-tenant? That affects rollout complexity.
Elaine (PM): Prefer global toggle for pilot, per-tenant in follow-up. Keep the pilot simple.
DeployBot: Reminder: staging deploy window reserved 2026-04-20 02:00 UTC.
Olivia (ProductOps): I'll create a short checklist for customer comms and opt-in, and add it to the launch doc.
Sam (Runtime): FYI — model-team reported a potential perf regression with quantized kv-cache on long sequences; will add perf test to staging matrix.
Elaine (PM): Great — thanks all. I'll update the roadmap lane and send a follow-up with confirmed dates after infra and security confirm. :white_check_mark:
